Acme Logistics closed Q3 2025 with two platform migrations and a reorganisation of the support
function. As a company focused on freight and last-mile delivery, the leadership team tracked
regional performance, headcount, pricing, service levels and vendor spend against the annual
plan, all of which are detailed in the sections that follow.

The Search platform is owned by the Platform team; its on-call lead for the quarter is Jonas
Meyer, who also chairs the weekly reliability review.

The finance team will publish a reconciliation to the statutory accounts after the audit.
